SELECT a.__value AS original, e."revenue" AS reference FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS __n, MAX("revenue") AS __value FROM (SELECT SUM(o.revenue) AS revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status IN ('paid') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-11-01') AS result) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS __present FROM (SELECT SUM(b."revenue") AS "revenue"
FROM "orders" AS b
WHERE "b"."status" IN ('paid') AND "b"."ordered_at" >= '2026-10-01' AND "b"."ordered_at" < '2026-11-01') AS expected_result) AS e ON TRUE WHERE a.__n IS NULL OR a.__n <> 1 OR e.__present IS NULL OR ((a.__value IS NULL) <> (e."revenue" IS NULL)) OR ABS(round_even(a.__value, 2) - round_even(e."revenue", 2)) > GREATEST(0, ABS(round_even(e."revenue", 2)) * 0)
